√mārg 'chase'
present: [1.] mārgati mārgate etc. E.+ 
[perfect: mamārga amārgīt ]
future: [1.] mārgiṣyati -- [2.] mārgitā 
verbal: mārgita E.+ mārgitum mārgitvā 
secondary: causative: mārgayati etc. E.+ 
derivatives: mārga E.+ mārgin E. mārgaṇa E.+ mārgitavya E.+ 
Really a denominative formation from mārga 'track'.
